notes.title: Hotfix, version 1.18h
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed: Resetting account/controls/achievements now more clear.
[*] Fixed: Was impossible to unlock achievements.
[*] Fixed: Can no longer get boss achievements if you die before the boss.
[*] Fixed: Host of bugs starting a new game while a game is in progress.
[*] Fixed: Timer showed over gold when playing Xia.
[*] Fixed: Gold placement was bad when souls and timer were both disabled.
[*] Fixed: Main Menu animations moved too fast with VSYNC off.
[*] Fixed: Changing key mapping with controller caused movement to get stuck.
[*] Fixed: Mapping move buttons on controller was supposed to be forbidden.
[*] Removed: Achievements queueing (was buggy anyhow).
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix, version 1.18e
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed: Account saving now creates backups to prevent save corruption.
[*] Changed: Mace now knocks monsters backwards.
[*] Fixed: Hearts were displaying for other characters, after playing Jie.
[*] Fixed: There was a case where multi-threading could mangle saves.
[*] Fixed: Game crashed when starting a new game while a game was in progress.
[*] Fixed: After finishing a daily dungeon, the "back" button was not appearing.
[*] Fixed: Mini Map option in main menu wasn't toggleable.
[*] Removed: "Pay" keybinding, as it is no longer used.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.18d Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added: Fullscreen vs Windowed-Fullscreen option in main menu.
[*] Added: Handful of new cast animations for monsters.
[*] Added: Handful of new missile animations. 
[*] Changed: Putrid Mask's effect dissipates on losing/removing mask.
[*] Changed: Putrid Mask requires you to be closer to bosses.
[*] Changed: Fade's illusions pretend to split with him.
[*] Changed: Glyph Swarm's missiles now more visible.
[*] Changed: All missiles flash to make them more visible. 
[*] Changed: Acid bottles properly point towards target.
[*] Changed: Box no longer possibly shoots lasers. 
[*] Changed: Hate Box now multiplies better.
[*] Changed: Souls Potion now gives fewer souls.
[*] Fixed: Missiles were too slow.
[*] Fixed: Hero names did not show up.
[*] Fixed: Death-rune-menu was inaccessible to gamepad players. 
[*] Fixed: Direction-key got stuck when changing input scheme.
[*] Fixed: Arena menu got stuck on screen when starting a match.
[*] Fixed: Missiles-hitting-wall effect sometimes not show up.
[*] Fixed: Blocking invisible wall appeared in desert area.
[*] Fixed: Arena was awarding wins to wrong monster.
[*] Fixed: Arena bosses weren't ending until you killed all summons.
[*] Fixed: Killing arena bosses wasn't wiping all small units. 
[*] Fixed: Arena was awarding multiple wins in a rare case.
[*] Fixed: Shadows were de-synching with monsters when pausing.
[*] Fixed: Position of dying monsters was incorrectly offset. 
[*] Fixed: Killing Mini Flaming Skull was acting as if you killed the boss. 
[*] Fixed: Animated Table was able to destroy stairs!
[*] Fixed: Brain wasn't killing itself in explosion.
[*] Fixed: Room was spawning with holes in the wall in Communications.
[*] Fixed: Putrid Mask was still affecting monsters when dead.

notes.title: 1.18 Hotfixes
notes.content:
1.18c ( July 23, 2016 )
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing mouse to get locked at 0,0 when not in Mouse+Keyboard mode.
[*] Fixed bug causing Brewery treasure rooms to not have doors.
[*] Removed "No Binding" from Jie's profile, until it's actually implemented.
[*] Removed ability to kill shopkeepers until it's actually implemented.
[/list]

1.18b ( July 22, 2016 )
[list]
[*] Added "Mouse Speed" option in Main Menu to change mouse sensitivity.
[*] Changed Achievements to work again.
[*] Changed Badass / Mega Badass achievements, splitting them into one for each character.
[*] Changed Lathe achievement back to needing 7 uses.
[*] Changed Souls rune to give more souls.
[*] Changed Spirit Armor to only recharge upon clearing a boss floor. 
[*] Fixed bug causing hero monsters to not spawn.
[*] Fixed bug displaying total number of possible runes wrong.
[*] Fixed bug causing game to not be paused when starting with tutorial open.
[/list]

1.18a ( July 19, 2016 )
[list]
[*] Changed teleportation to not take you into hidden rooms.
[*] Fixed bug with deciding which tiles are in treasure rooms.
[*] Fixed bug causing wavy things at edge of sight to be repetitive.
[/list]

notes.title: July Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added animations for all monsters.
[*] Added system to give Rune Coins upon the player dying.
[*] Added 3 new playable characters, each with own tradeoffs.
[*] Added graphical effect for unseen areas.
[*] Added messages when toggling UI elements. 
[*] Added new scheme for generating every level in the game.
[*] Added more variants to every boss room.
[*] Added mouse support to game menus.
[*] Added treasure rooms.
[*] Added flash to interactable objects.
[*] Added new item: Recharge Scroll.
[*] Added new item: Magic Potion.
[*] Added new item: Anti Berserk Potion.
[*] Added new item: Anti Dexterity Potion.
[*] Added new item: Anti ESP Potion.
[*] Added new item: Anti Full Health Potion.
[*] Added new item: Healing Potion.
[*] Added new item: Invisibility Potion.
[*] Added new item: Purge Potion.
[*] Added new item: Resist Potion.
[*] Added new item: Souls Potion.
[*] Added new item: Speed Potion.
[*] Added new item: Stamina Potion.
[*] Added new item: Attack Charm.
[*] Added new item: Gold Charm.
[*] Added new item: Key Charm.
[*] Added new item: Life Saving Charm.
[*] Added new item: Resist Charm.
[*] Added new item: Soul Charm.
[*] Added new item: Stamina Charm.
[*] Added new item: Stasis Charm.
[*] Added new item: Speed Charm.
[*] Added new item: Tumble Charm.
[*] Added new item: Boomerang.
[*] Changed Rune editing page to be accessible from game over.
[*] Changed duration of veil cloak to be much shorter.
[*] Changed veil cloak to be VERY fragile. 
[*] Changed Drider to have a knife for melee.
[*] Changed acid blob to infrequently shoot.
[*] Changed melee acid to break items. 
[*] Changed shot acid to immediately break items. 
[*] Changed shot acid to be more quick. 
[*] Changed Rune Coins to no longer drop from monsters.
[*] Changed UI elements to work with new characters' traits.
[*] Changed mechanism for displaying most bosses you beat while winning. 
[*] Changed bubble armor appearance.
[*] Changed invisibility appearance.
[*] Changed alert messages to have a larger font.
[*] Changed item descriptions to have a larger font. 
[*] Changed placement of item name in inventory. 
[*] Changed message clearing to no longer consume input. 
[*] Changed attacks to use stamina.
[*] Changed tumble to use more stamina.
[*] Changed stamina system to restore faster.
[*] Changed stamina system to lock out if you run out of stamina.
[*] Changed visual representation of stamina.
[*] Changed breaking chests to break items far more often.
[*] Changed items broken inside chests to always turn to scrap.
[*] Changed soul granularity by 10x.
[*] Changed Repair Scroll to no longer charge wands.
[*] Changed Repair Scroll to randomly choose, if no weapon is wielded.
[*] Changed non-teleportation/blink scrolls to appear in smaller amounts.
[*] Changed souls to no longer heal.
[*] Changed minimap so player location is more obvious.
[*] Changed heart bar to flash when you gain/lose health.
[*] Changed durable skill to increase item durability more.
[*] Changed harden scroll to only increase durability by 40.
[*] Changed lathe system back to needing increasing scraps.
[*] Changed wants to no longer affect bosses.
[*] Changed whips to be harmless if you're stone-proof.
[*] Changed laserbrand weapons to get heavily damaged upon shooting.
[*] Changed laserbrand laser to be much faster.
[*] Changed tutorial to reflect new characters. 
[*] Changed death angle to be random if no source is found.
[*] Changed missiles to face exact angle, rather than lock to 8 directions.
[*] Changed arena to no longer give you rune buffs. 
[*] Changed genocide prompt to be easier / more visual.
[*] Changed monsters to not be able to push you while attacking. 
[*] Changed main menu to allow you to start a new game instead of loading.
[*] Fixed bug allowing player to break their own missiles by attacking.
[*] Fixed bug causing monsters to walk diagonally through walls.
[*] Fixed bug causing unseen monsters' shadows to get drawn.
[*] Fixed bug causing items' autopickup status to not get saved. 
[*] Fixed conflicts if update and account-error message were both open.
[*] Fixed bug preventing swapping Rune placements in some cases.
[*] Fixed hearts drawing under effigies in inventory menu.
[*] Fixed bug in reporting how many items in a chest broke.
[*] Fixed bug causing Blink Scroll to sometimes take a long time. 
[*] Fixed bug making monsters drop souls after stepping on Soul Drain Trap.
[*] Fixed bug where pausing just before dying would stick into new game.
[*] Fixed bug causing Cactuses (the monster) to spawn on top of each other.
[*] Fixed fullscreen map to be properly centered.
[*] Fixed fullscreen map to cover screen fully. 
[*] Fixed bug in tutorial, displaying keyboard controls wrong.
[*] Fixed bug causing cursor to draw over map.
[*] Fixed bug allowing you to open inventory at same time as the map.
[*] Fixed bug with Mace's hitbox.
[*] Fixed bug causing Book Worm's books to not aim for you.
[*] Fixed crash while genociding species of a monster on current level.
[*] Fixed crash from (somehow!) genociding every single species. 
[*] Fixed bug causing genocides to carry over between games. 
[*] Removed Haste Scroll.
[*] Removed Invisibility Scroll
[/list]
